title: Modern physics and special relativity
purpose: Use spacetime reasoning and explain the experimental motivations for quantum and atomic physics.
primary_reading: MIT 8.033 Introduction to Relativity and Spacetime Physics (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Calculate events in two frames with units and conventions.
Explain what classical model fails and compute a quantitative prediction.
Week 7 midterm; estimate a localization energy scale.
Compare a model energy spectrum with its assumptions.
Work decay and binding energy problems; identify conservation laws.
Submit the comparison and take an unseen modern physics final.

project: Compare nonrelativistic and relativistic predictions for one specified particle scenario.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
